articles.title: AI agents could drain cheap bank deposits, Apollo's Torsten Slok warns
articles.snippet: AI agents could trigger a bank run by automatically moving household cash from low-interest checking accounts to higher-yield alternatives, Slok warns.

articles.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
articles.snippet: The new software lets companies add custom security checks so they do not fall victim to the same type of vulnerabilities that plagued rival bridges.

articles.title: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
articles.snippet: CoinDesk found 27 successful swaps moving about 2,390 ETH into 75.2 BTC, even as Bitget urged THORChain to stop serving addresses tied to the $387.5 million theft.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to $83,000 while altcoins unwind Friday's rally
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.7% to $83,000, though the CoinDesk 100 dropped 2.6% as Friday's biggest gainers reversed and oil climbed back above $100.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains under pressure as Iran denies report of peace progress
articles.snippet: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield is sharply higher again, rising to a new cycle high above 5.27%.
